parsed.label: Adjusted EBITDA

figures.quote: Adjusted EBITDA was $107.0 million for the quarter, up $12.0 million, or up 12.7%, from the same period in 2024, driven by both acquisition contribution and organic growth .
Adjusted EBITDA was $422.8 million for fiscal year 2025, up $62.2 million, or up 17.3%, from fiscal year 2024, driven by both acquisition contribution and organic growth.

parsed.notes: The reconciliation table (in thousands) is cut off before the Adjusted EBITDA row, so figures come from the narrative text. Prior-year amounts are not printed directly. They are implied by the stated increases: Q4 2024 about $95.0 million and FY2024 about $360.6 million. Because they are derived rather than printed, they are not listed. FY2026 guidance of $455-465 million is excluded because it is a forecast.
